children: ), a global technology and services leader, today announced it will release the financial results of its fiscal third quarter 2026 after market close on Tuesday, September 29, 2026. The Company will also host a conference call and webcast with the investment community to discuss the financial results on
Tuesday, September 29, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time

The live and replay conference call webcast will be available in listen-only mode under Events and Presentations on the Investor Relations section of the Concentrix website, along with other investor resources including an updated company presentation.
